_doc: THE BUTTERFLY EFFECT — chain grammar. Each journal dive rewrites one life: a new lane per rewritten present. The film presents overwrites; the chart keeps every world it abandoned (a rewrite that erased a lane would be lying about what the chart can show).

meta.title: The Butterfly Effect — The Rewritten Lives
meta.subtitle: Every journal dive rewrites the world · the abandoned life runs on (grey) · the horror compounds
meta.thread_label: THE THREAD: CHILDHOOD → THE CAMPUS LIFE → THE PRISON LIFE → THE AMPUTEE LIFE → THE ENDING
meta.footer: Test film 3 of 4 — chain grammar: arcs back, lanes sideways. Cites = act markers, not scene numbers.

nodes.title: The Opening Life — the Blackouts
nodes.body: Evan's childhood: the blackouts, the missing hours. His mother watches him lose whole minutes he never lived.

OPEN.beat: Childhood: the knife, the mailbox firework, the film camera — the blackouts cover the wounds
Seven years later: the journals. First dive.

CAMP.beat: Age 7 rewritten — he keeps Kayleigh from her father's camera

CAMP.segment: THE CAMPUS LIFE (fraternity, Kayleigh his girlfriend)

CAMP.beat: Tommy, unhinged, escalates — the horror finds the new world too
Second dive — back to age 13, the mailbox

PRIS.beat: Age 13 rewritten — he saves Lenny's mother

PRIS.segment: THE PRISON LIFE (Tommy dead by his hand · mom's diagnosis · Kayleigh gone grey)

PRIS.beat: Third dive — to the Seventh-Sunday lunch, to fix Lenny

AMP.beat: Age 13 rewritten again — Lenny saved, Tommy reformed, his own hands blown off

AMP.segment: THE AMPUTEE LIFE (mom dies of cancer · Kayleigh with Lenny · the bathtub dive, no journal)

AMP.beat: Fourth dive — back to the film camera, the first wound

COMA.beat: Age 7 rewritten — the camera is knocked away; the blast takes not his hands but the thirteen years

COMA.segment: THE INSTITUTION LIFE (a mind that has never had a body to lose)

COMA.beat: Final dive — through the home movies, out of every world

ending.title: Before His Own Birth
ending.body: The last dive goes past every journal, past every camera — out of the timeline entirely. The institution world runs on, empty of him.

dive5.label: the last dive — before his own birth

legend: Each dive (green arc) rewrites one life: a new lane, entered in its childhood. The horror compounds with every fix.
The abandoned lives RUN ON (grey chips) — the film shows overwrites; the chart keeps every world.
Chain grammar: no split circles — the mechanism is travel to a changed past, not a fork.
